description: Life/car accident update and unbox some gifts with me!  Thank you Wyatt, S.S., Sherri, and Arc Mate! These are such wonderful gifts and I am so grateful for your ongoing support while I’m healing from my accident! ❤️ #injury #caraccident #unboxing #gifts #thankful
transcript: Hi, I'm Emily and I'm on a mission to pick up 1 million pieces of litter and I have been completely MIA for the past month So I want to go over what's been going on in my life And then I'll open some packages that I got that I did not order that I assume are from you guys So for starters, I haven't posted in the past month because I got into a car accident on October 7th I just got engaged the day before and I went to the mall to find an engagement dress And as I was driving in the mall parking lot, a car came out and hit me It was a low speed impact But that didn't take away from the fact that I did get injured So I was in an accident two and a half to three years ago where I herniated six discs down my back And I took that first year after the accident to get everything corrected and I've been good since then But this accident re herniated all of those discs and I'm having all of that pain again In addition to everything going on with my back, I also really messed up my shoulder in this accident So in my right shoulder, I have what's called an SLAP tear as well as a torn rotator cuff And I believe it stands for superior labrum anterior to posterior Which is the tissue that connects the humerus to the shoulder bone and that is torn So at the top of your humerus bone is a ball And then the shoulder has a little nook that it sits in so the humerus sits in the shoulder like this And there's soft tissue in here where those bones are connected So right here is that piece of soft tissue that connects that humerus into that shoulder joint And that is what tore Doctors notes up here say what our course of actions are if physical therapy and the cortisone shot don't work I have to do what's called a PRP injection If that doesn't work then I may be looking at surgery So every time I move my shoulder it makes this really nasty cracking sound And being that I have to use my arms in order to clean up litter I haven't been able to go out and clean up I did just get a cortisone shot in my shoulder this week and I'm starting physical therapy soon So I'm hoping everything will be okay And then I'm also going to be in the process of getting Ablations and going to the chiropractor to fix what's going on with my back. So it all really really stinks I'm not happy about it at all and it took away from our ability to celebrate our engagement which also really sucks So yeah, even just sitting here on the floor right now. I am in pain my back hurts pretty bad Luckily my shoulder has cortisone in it right now So I'm able to kind of move it more than I normally would But because of that I want to get some of these packages Opened so I can express my gratitude for all of you guys even though I haven't been around lately I had two packages and a letter come to my PO box as well as a package to my apartment So I am assuming that's from my Amazon wishlist So let's open these up and see what you guys sent Package number one. This one says it's from Wyatt and I have gotten packages from Wyatt before They have been bags. So I'm assuming that's what this is going to be as well That's a cute little card And they are a whole bunch of bags So I send cigarette butts off to a company called TerraCycle But the cigarettes do have to be contained in a sealed bag And so I really like to use resealable bags And I love it when I get things like this Because they will definitely go to good use Thank you Wyatt so much for your support Now the letter Oh too funny So this is from SS And they sent me some receipts that I can use to scan into the receipt scanning apps In order to make money doing this project Because I really don't make a lot on my videos I scan receipts into a variety of different apps Where I get gift cards So that's very kind of you Thank you so much Package number two This one is very heavy Oh cinnamon That's funny I was just looking at these At the store the other day Some fancy feast for cinnamon It's a food In here is also Crossing the Delaware and American women quarters To add to my quarter collection And these came from Sherry Thank you so so much Sherry I am so grateful for that I love collecting coins So I'm really excited to have that for the quarters And then this is going to be for cinnamon So thank you so much Oh my body Oh you're so loved She likes it Cinnamon says oh thank you Thank you so much And package number three I do believe I know what this is And who it came from So on my Facebook I had somebody reach out from a company That designs grabber tools And said that they wanted to send me some little goodies So let's open it up Oh cool My name So this company is called ArcMate And I will add them to my link tree The way that I have other products that I use And this is the style of grabber tool How it's got my name on it That is so cool That is so cool And there's more These are orangutans That's funny Aha there we go And these are the style that I typically use And it's got this little sharp end there That's nifty I've never seen that before I've only ever seen magnets right there before That's cool Ooh I love this It says that they have launched A new recycling program For old broken or worn out reachers Simply fill out the form on their website Receive a shipping label And send back your tools And then it also says Show us how you reach If you're out there making a difference We'd love to see it Whether you're solo or with the group Your work deserves to be seen Snap a photo of your team in action Share it to social media and tag them Look how cool this is Wow That is cool Thank you Wyatt Thank you Sherry Thank you SS Je vous dis à
